scenario_results.observed: MigrationIntegrationTest on Testcontainers PostgreSQL 16 (server_version_num asserted): blank database migrated by Flyway to version 1 with app_user and idempotency_record; duplicate issuer+subject and duplicate actor+command+key raise DuplicateKeyException while other actor/command succeed; locale, E.164 phone, phone-verified-without-phone, status, idempotency hash and <24h retention CHECKs and actor FK reject invalid rows. ModuleBoundaryTest: all nine modules declared and imported; production code passes api-only, acyclic, layering rules; the same rules report the fixture's finance.internal -> orders.internal dependency and its api-level cycle. ApiErrorIntegrationTest: 404/400/415/405/422/409/500 return the standard body with request ID and no internal detail.

findings: Initial run: module presence test failed because documentation-only package-info files produce no class files and the jar import filter excluded reactor module jars; repaired with @DomainModule package annotations and package-based import (assertions unchanged, strengthened to require annotation name = package).
Catch-all exception handler will need explicit Spring Security mappings (401/403) in MB-009 so authentication failures are not reported as 500.
app_user/idempotency_record schemas follow docs/engineering/02-data-model.md; UUIDs assigned by the application (version selected when identity/orders services are written).
Domain modules contain only declarations and api packages so far; no behavior is claimed for them.
